_readme: PSA configuration — controls sampling, outputs, and metrics. Separate from model config. Do not add PSA settings to v11_configuration.json.

n_draws.notes: Number of PSA iterations. 1000 is standard for HTA submissions; use 20-100 for development testing.

method.notes: Sampling method: 'lhs' (Latin Hypercube Sampling) or 'random' (simple Monte Carlo). LHS preferred for HTA.

seed.notes: RNG seed for reproducibility of PSA parameter draws. Fixed seed ensures same draws across runs.

tiers_to_sample.notes: Which parameter tiers to include. Default: only Tier 3 (uncertain). Add 'estimated' to also vary Tier 2 calibrated params — only do this after full calibration.

exclude_parameters.notes: Dot-paths of Tier-3 parameters to exclude from sampling. Example: ['transmission_model.disease.transmission.beta_acute']

include_parameters.notes: If non-empty, ONLY these dot-paths are sampled (overrides tier discovery). Use for targeted one-way sensitivity analysis.

correlation_groups.notes: FUTURE (BACKLOG): Groups of parameters with enforced rank correlation. E.g., [{'params': ['beta_chronic', 'epsilon_msm'], 'rank_correlation': 0.6}]. Not implemented in V11.10.

enabled.notes: If true, run PSA across multiple HTA scenarios (PSA x scenario grid). Requires hta_config.json. Not implemented in V11.10 MVP.

reference_scenario.notes: Reference scenario for computing incremental outcomes. Used only when scenarios.enabled = true.

extract.name: cumulative_infections
extract.notes: Total new HIV infections over the full simulation horizon

extract.name: final_prevalence
extract.notes: HIV prevalence at the final simulation year

extract.name: cumulative_hiv_deaths
extract.notes: Cumulative HIV-attributable deaths over simulation horizon

extract.name: mean_incidence_rate
extract.notes: Mean annual HIV incidence rate over 2000-2020 calibration window

directory.notes: Output directory for PSA results. Created if it does not exist.

raw_draws.notes: Write full parameter draws matrix (N x K) and outcome matrix (N x M) as CSV files.

summary_excel.notes: Write summary Excel workbook: parameter_summary, outcome_summary, raw_draws, raw_outcomes, tornado_data, convergence tabs.

tornado.notes: Spearman rank correlation tornado diagram. top_n capped at number of parameters.

histogram.notes: Distribution of outcome metrics across PSA draws.

convergence.notes: Running mean ± 95% CI vs. draw count. Justifies that N is sufficient.

dpi.notes: Plot resolution. 150 for development, 300 for publication.

enabled.notes: If true, also sample cost/utility/AE parameters from hta_config.json.

exclude_placeholders.notes: If true, skip parameters with distribution_status='placeholder'. Set true when BACKLOG-15 is incomplete.

exclude_parameters.notes: Dot-paths of HTA parameters to exclude from sampling.
